☀️ Your money this morning, Monday 23 November

🇺🇸 Friday in New York: a heavy sell-off led by AI and chip shares. The Nasdaq fell 5.3% and wiped out its gains for 2026. The S&P 500 fell 3.7% and the Dow 1.9%, and both are now 10% or more below their peaks (a "correction").

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 1.6% lower on Friday.

🪙 This morning gold is up 2.3% at about $3,613. The rand is slightly firmer at about R17.46 to the dollar, and Brent oil is about $92.66.

What it means for you: if your retirement savings hold global shares, expect a weaker statement this month. Market falls like this have happened before, and one bad week says little about the long run.

Prices are 15-minute delayed (06:51). Education, not financial advice.
